subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI ever auto-fetch remote Markdown image URLs from assistant output, and if yes under what opt-in/proxy policy?
rationale: Current code, tests, and docs intentionally prevent remote image fetches; reversing that default changes the operator-browser privacy boundary and cannot be decided by cleanup automation.

options.title: Keep Default Deny
options.body: Keep flattening remote Markdown images and close or redirect this request to the broader inline media policy discussion if maintainers do not want browser remote fetches.

options.title: Add Controlled Opt-In
options.body: Preserve the default block but add a maintainer-approved allowlist, proxy, or setting with tests and docs for both blocked and enabled modes.

options.title: Allow Direct http/https Images
options.body: Render remote images directly and relax CSP, accepting that assistant text can make the operator browser contact arbitrary image hosts.

recommendation.title: Add Controlled Opt-In
recommendation.body: Preserve the default block but add a maintainer-approved allowlist, proxy, or setting with tests and docs for both blocked and enabled modes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current CSP hardening that defines the strongest security boundary involved in this decision.
